We have trained model and have training and test metrics, feature importance. Next need cross-validation results. Use perform_cross_validation tool. Provide train_data_path and hyperparameters. Also need to produce final JSON file with test_set_evaluation (mae, rmse, r2, feature_importance) and cross_validation_results (r2_mean, r2_std). We'll need to combine data.

We have test metrics from training: mae 0.234025..., rmse 0.308450..., r2 0.859641..., feature_importance dict.

Now run cross-validation.
